workload: Successful getrusage tail and sentinel verification in the existing EL0 payload. Compare the payload, fixture disk, normal linked kernels and static stack records with ab24e7bb5.
assessment: The EL0 payload gains 320 text bytes and a 192-byte probe frame. The entry frame is unchanged. The compressed disk grows by 171 bytes and RPi5 linked read-only data grows by 160 bytes. QEMU linked text, read-only data and data are byte-identical; both usable RAM starts are unchanged.
next_trigger: Remeasure when the scalar ABI fixtures change allocation workload or an embedded payload grows across a reservation boundary.
